written_before: any drive of polaris_u_grad, polaris_u_cem or straight6_polaris_u (none existed; the 16-row pilot comes after this spec)
question: Does the f104-trained Polaris planner (all tiers, polaris_full_soil) reach the goal safely on >= 90 % of the 1,000 declared soil pairs of the 8 unseen test arenas, planning from a standing start with each arena's own overhead map?

descriptions.polaris_u_grad: own model + CEM 4 x 64 + gradient refinement (ov_grad_picks.py = ci_grad defaults), standing start
descriptions.polaris_u_cem: own model + CEM 4 x 64 (ag_picks.py --mode free), standing start
descriptions.straight6_polaris_u: the straight 6 m/s route (K3 e6/picks/crm/<arena>/straight6), driven by the Polaris

label: unsafe_belly

label_meaning.unsafe_belly: not reached safely: goal not reached, OR unsafe (roll-back under throttle >= 0.05 s or min forward speed <= -0.30 m/s after the 1 s settle), OR belly flag
label_meaning.fail: goal not reached (goal-only rate, reported beside)

readout.pooled: rate = 100 x share of the 1,000 pairs reached safely; 95 % intervals: Wilson (pairs), pair bootstrap, cluster bootstrap over (arena, nearest feature), arena bootstrap (8 arenas resampled with replacement, pooled rate of the resampled pairs); t interval over the 8 arena rates reported beside
readout.clearly_above: meets AND lower end of the two-sided 95 % arena-bootstrap interval >= 90.0
readout.per_arena: rate, Wilson 95 %, pair bootstrap 95 %; vs 90: above if Wilson lower >= 90, below if Wilson upper < 90, else not distinguishable from 90
readout.failed_drives: a declared pair whose drive failed twice on the cluster (no completed run) counts as NOT reached safely and as a crash (validity)
readout.missing_drives: any other declared pair without a drive of the primary arm -> verdict incomplete (interim numbers on the driven pairs)

validity.note: PLAN 4.3(c) / 9.1 item 6; only the primary arm gates the verdict

context.note: context only, not tests: the HMMWV planners of the Gator study (f104 only = M1, three arenas = M3, A3) on the same 1,000 pairs; the HMMWV has no belly record, so safe = not unsafe
